payload.title: V1 · Official Build
payload.summary: The refreshed official build with the new automatic-update popup.
releaseNotes: A Settings-style update popup with verified release details and actual release notes.
Live download progress, measured speed and estimated time remaining.
Closing the popup preserves the download; Settings stays synchronized.
Explicit cancellation, retry and guarded installer opening.
Responsive layout, keyboard focus, reduced motion and fullscreen-safe automatic offers.
Existing background downloads, Library, playback and conversion features retained.
